answer: Assign every applicant to a random cohort at a narrow inlet, twelve strangers per plot. Each cohort posts a pooled bond of 1,200 POA, and every member must answer the epoch's liveness pulse in the same window; if any proves a clone or misses it, a quarter of the bond burns. Because members come from the applicant pool, a farm cannot surround itself with its own keys: N clones need N/12 cohorts, each risking 1,200 POA plus eleven strangers who lose money for its conduct. An honest agent joins one garden and keeps it weeded; mass registration pays the bond and risk repeatedly.
